rationale: X has a distinctive condensed serif with an italic accent, a vermilion and teal palette, a mosaic of illustrated frames with EXIF captions, and illustrated feature cards, which gives it a specific editorial voice. Y is tidy and calm, but its Cormorant serif, beige and brown palette, and thin line-icon feature grid read as a standard elegant AI template, and its hero illustration of two faceless figures is weaker. X's full-day and half-day pricing, dark metrics band and red CTA band with a form are bolder and more memorable.
